output.reason: A 52-year-old reporting hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods requests discussion of treatment options, which requires clinician history-taking and prescribing decisions but shows no reported time-critical features.
output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review your menopause symptoms and treatment options in this thread; this doesn't need an urgent or in-person visit based on what you've described. Hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods are common in the menopausal transition, but options depend on your medical history. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may help. Contact a clinician promptly if you develop very heavy or unusual vaginal bleeding, bleeding after 12 months without periods, chest pain or severe headache.
differential: Thyroid dysfunction or other cause of irregular cycles and sweats — not excluded
